en.name: Brie
en.summary: Brie is a soft cheese ripened from the outside in by the white mould on its rind, which means it is always changing and never stops. Refrigerated at 4 °C (40 °F) or below it keeps 1–2 weeks from the day of purchase, and about 6 months in the freezer, though freezing is a compromise.
en.pantry: Brie is a high-moisture, low-acid soft cheese and it must be kept refrigerated. Listeria monocytogenes is the specific concern with cheeses of this kind: it is the organism that soft, moist, low-acid cheeses favour, and unusually it can still grow slowly at fridge temperatures, let alone on a warm table. Serve brie at room temperature for taste by all means, but that means half an hour or so, not an afternoon — the two-hour rule applies, one hour above 32 °C (90 °F).
en.fridge: Store brie at 4 °C (40 °F) or below in the main compartment, in its original box or wrapped in waxed paper, never sealed tightly in cling film — the rind is alive and suffocating it makes the paste turn to ammonia. It keeps 1–2 weeks from purchase. A firm, chalky centre means it is young; a paste that bulges when cut means it is fully ripe and should be eaten now. If you are pregnant or immunocompromised, soft and semi-soft cheeses are best avoided unless thoroughly cooked, and that advice applies to pasteurised brie as well as to raw-milk brie.
en.freezer: Brie freezes for about 6 months from purchase at −18 °C (0 °F), but the texture never fully recovers: it thaws grainier and wetter, and the ripening that gives brie its character stops for good. Freeze it in wedges, wrapped airtight, and plan to bake it whole, fold it into a sauce or melt it into a tart rather than serve it on a board.
en.thawing: Thaw brie slowly in the fridge overnight, still wrapped, and use it within a couple of days. Never thaw it at room temperature, which is precisely the condition Listeria likes. Do not refreeze it.
spoilage: A strong ammonia smell — a hint is normal in a ripe brie, a sharp reek is not
Coloured mould on the rind: grey, blue-green, black or pink patches among the white
A rind that has gone slimy, sticky or brown, or paste leaking out
A bitter or acrid taste, or a rind that tastes of nothing but ammonia
tips: Buy the size you will finish within a week or two; brie does not wait.
Keep it in its wooden box or wrap it in waxed paper so the rind can breathe.
Take it out 30 minutes before serving, then put the rest away promptly.
Never cut mould off a soft cheese — unlike hard cheese, the threads run right through the paste.

faq.q: How long does brie last in the fridge?
faq.a: 1–2 weeks from the day of purchase at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, wrapped in paper rather than plastic film.
Yes, for about 6 months at −18 °C (0 °F), but it thaws grainy and wet. Freeze it only if you intend to bake or melt it.

faq.q: Can you eat the rind of brie?
faq.a: Yes, the white bloomy rind is edible and is part of the cheese. If it has turned grey, brown or slimy, the cheese has gone too far.

faq.q: Can you cut mould off brie?
faq.a: No. Soft cheeses hold enough moisture for mould and bacteria to spread through the whole paste, so unexpected coloured mould means the whole piece goes.

zh.name: 布里起司
zh.summary: 布里是靠外皮上的白黴由外往內熟成的軟質起司，也就是說它一直在變化、而且不會停下來。4°C 以下冷藏，從購買當天算起可放 1～2 週；冷凍約 6 個月，但那是一種妥協。
zh.pantry: 布里屬於高含水、低酸度的軟質起司，必須全程冷藏。這類起司特別要留意的是李斯特菌：軟質、濕潤、低酸的起司正是它偏好的環境，而且它即使在冷藏溫度下也還能緩慢生長，更別說放在溫熱的餐桌上。為了風味讓布里回到室溫當然沒問題，但指的是半小時左右，不是一整個下午——兩小時原則同樣適用，氣溫超過 32°C 時只有一小時。
zh.fridge: 冷藏維持 4°C 以下，放在冰箱主室，用原本的木盒或蠟紙包著，千萬不要用保鮮膜緊緊密封——外皮是活的，悶住它會讓內部整個變成阿摩尼亞味。從購買日起可放 1～2 週。切開後中心還是白白粉粉、偏硬，代表熟成度還輕；一切開就往外流，代表已經完全熟成，要盡快吃完。孕婦和免疫力較弱的人，除非徹底加熱，否則建議避開軟質與半軟質起司，而且這個建議對殺菌乳製的布里同樣成立，不只針對生乳製品。
zh.freezer: 布里在 −18°C 冷凍，從購買日起約可放 6 個月，但質地回不來：解凍後會變得顆粒感重、出水，而且賦予布里個性的熟成過程也就此終止。請切成小塊密封冷凍，並打算用來整顆焗烤、融進醬汁或做鹹派，而不是切片上拼盤。
zh.thawing: 解凍請連著包裝放冷藏室慢慢退冰一晚，並在兩天內用完。絕對不要在室溫解凍，那正是李斯特菌喜歡的條件。解凍後不要再冷凍。
spoilage: 強烈的阿摩尼亞味——熟成布里帶一點是正常的，刺鼻嗆人就不是
外皮的白黴中夾雜灰色、藍綠色、黑色或粉紅色的黴斑
外皮變得黏滑、發黏或轉褐，或內餡整個流出來
吃起來苦澀嗆口，或外皮只剩阿摩尼亞味
tips: 買一兩週內吃得完的份量，布里不會等人。
放在原本的木盒裡或用蠟紙包，讓外皮能呼吸。
上桌前 30 分鐘拿出來回溫，吃完立刻收回冰箱。
軟質起司絕對不要「把霉切掉繼續吃」——和硬起司不同，菌絲會貫穿整塊。

faq.q: 布里起司放冰箱可以放多久？
faq.a: 4°C 以下冷藏，從購買當天算起 1～2 週。用紙包而不是用保鮮膜密封。
可以，放 −18°C 約 6 個月，但解凍後質地會變粗、會出水。只有打算焗烤或融化使用時才建議冷凍。
可以，白色的外皮本來就是起司的一部分。但如果它已經轉灰、轉褐或變黏，就代表這塊起司過頭了。

faq.q: 布里發霉可以把霉切掉嗎？
faq.a: 不行。軟質起司含水量高，黴菌和細菌會蔓延到整塊裡面，只要出現不該有的雜色黴，整塊都要丟棄。
